atlases.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: TRANSPARENT COMPLETE CASTLE GAME SPRITE ATLAS, not freestanding rooms. Edit target reference is paired closed/open castle: use ONLY THE RIGHT OPEN CUTAWAY CASTLE. Make exactly SIX identical-geometry complete copies of that open castle, strict 3 columns x 2 rows, one complete castle per equal cell with transparent separation. Landscape canvas 3072x1536. Preserve the EXACT original castle silhouette, overall proportions, all existing floor heights, each arch shape, stair positions, wall/floor materials, camera, terrace, wheels and tower. Do NOT make rooms smaller, add floors, or put rectangular framed room modules inside the arches. The identity is 목재 개척 농장, materials warm honey timber and iron brackets. Warm rounded SD 3D rendering matches reference. Functional rooms IN THIS ORDER: grain farming and dairy with sprouts, grain mill and milk churn. Exact target sectors measured within the full open castle body bounding box, origin top-left, x/right y/down: room1 rectangle x=0.08 y=0.48 w=0.55 h=0.23. Keep each function inside its existing sector, adapt furnishings to that actual room, no need to fill all space with furniture. Make roles UNMISTAKABLY DISTINCT IN OBJECT SHAPES AND COLORS: production = leaf-green growing crops, cream food supplies and clear cyan glass vessels; equipment attack workshop = charcoal grey heavy metal, bright ORANGE forge fire, blue steel equipment, cyan blueprint bench; restaurant/tavern = CRIMSON upholstery/tablecloths, food-covered tables, amber barrels and instruments; library/religion = COBALT BLUE and IVORY, tall bookshelves and sacred altar; royal specialization = WHITE-GOLD elegant greenhouse/banquet furnishings, rose flowers, lush plants. Preserve original castle wall palette around these colored furnishings. These are productive/living facilities, NEVER generic throne rooms for every function. Left to right top row stages are base,upgrade1,upgrade2; bottom row upgrade3,upgrade4,upgrade5. Base already clearly shows the correct function. Each successive stage adds visibly more advanced tools, productive apparatus or furnishings, NOT a tint change. Maintain believable HUMAN-SIZED furnishing scale relative to actual doorways/stairs, leave clear front standing/walking strips for large pixel NPCs. No people. No cannon (drawn separately by engine). No exterior scenery, text, labels or UI. Genuine transparent background outside six castle sprites. NO standalone framed rooms, no fixed stacks of generic brown rooms, no camera changes between stages.
